usedFor: Clientary holds invoices and estimates, and “New Invoice” there can start “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice” in Clientary, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: It makes a file reachable by shareable link with Viewer, Commenter or Editor access as soon as an invoice exists.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” opens a file to anyone with the link, so check the access level you set.
